title: The Flash Pursuit of Justice Part One: Speed City
original_title: The Flash Pursuit of Justice Part One: Speed City
overview: After a devastating Speed Force storm rocks Central City, Barry Allen, aka The Flash, must lead a new team of speedsters with the help of newly powered Dr. Meena Dhawan and Detective August Heart.  But as sinister echoes from Barry's past resurface, a growing mystery threatens the team's new normal and the future of Central City itself.
